item.title: Bulletin updated at 19:05 HKT 26/Oct/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry northeast monsoon will bring fine weather to southern China persistently for the rest of this week. Under the influence of a replenishment of the northeast monsoon, winds will strengthen from the north and the weather will be very dry over the coast of Guangdong early to midweek next week. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large. Besides, the area of low pressure over the seas east of the Philippines now is expected to develop into a tropical cyclone gradually and edge closer to the vicinity of Luzon in the latter part of this week. It will then turn northeast and move in the general direction of the Ryukyu Islands.
